scope: Four physical HOB cards and reusable typed rules; no identity additions. Author evidence does not establish whole-set acceptance.

cards.name: Sound the Trumpets
obligations: Counter target spell; capture current stack mana value including declared X before the counter attempt.
Recruit at mana value <=2 even when countering fails; no recruit for a vanished target.
Real private discard, land/nonland outcomes, and owned post-counter continuation.

cards.name: Gnashing of Teeth
obligations: Paid modal -5/-5 and exact-incarnation death-to-exile replacement through cleanup.
Replacement registers before zero-toughness SBA and survives source spell departure.
Player-targeted -1/-1 freezes current creatures, ignores their hexproof, survives controller changes, and excludes future entrants.

cards.name: Stone by Sunlight
obligations: Destroy only power>=4, checked again at resolution.
Artifact addition preserves other types, colors, base stats, counters and subtypes; grant indestructible until cleanup.
Adding artifact must not retain creature after a later layer-one copy removes creature; independently crewed vehicles remain creatures.
Stale incarnations do not inherit the effects; representative owned characteristic roots restore exactly.

cards.name: Through the Forest Gate
obligations: Private top20 look, optional zero/some/all land selection, reject nonlands and card21.
Selected lands enter simultaneously tapped, supporting suspended entry-value decisions.
Shuffle the full remaining library including cards outside the looked range, then gain8; empty library and no eligible lands still gain8.
Owned raw/index branches and snapshot restore at private selection and suspended entry-choice roots.

shared_changes.characteristics: Existing artifact=true/preserve_card_types=true rows add artifact only; crew shortcut ignores artifact-only rows. No new owned State fields or wire shape.

validation.simulation_benchmarks: None executed; full-set games/performance remain integration work.

integration: Obtain two independent nonauthor reviews of the settled source and assembled final published candidate.
Run required release acceptance on the assembled frozen checkpoint.
